candidates.explanation: The access-token strategy verifies tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret', but access tokens are signed in AuthService.getTokensData with 'auth.secret'. Signature verification always fails, so every request with a fresh access token gets 401, while login and refresh (which use the refresh strategy) work.

fix.description: Use 'auth.secret' instead of 'auth.refreshSecret' as secretOrKey in JwtStrategy.
